texts390.text: 15-minute jackpots. One ticket starts it all.
Connect your wallet to play. Minimum 0.1 IMD.
The table is getting ready. Entries open once the owner configures IMD.
Anyone can finalize a closed round
Commit a block 3 blocks ahead, then return to settle the draw. Anyone can call both steps.
Connect to see your points and multiplier.
Unlocks after 10 settled rounds. Caps at 2×.
Connect your wallet to check your prizes.
Winning tickets appear after the first round settles.
Up to 10 recent rounds. A player can win more than one place.
Burns and house fees appear here when rounds settle.
Deferred transfers are owed by the contract; they have not been sent.
Each ticket costs 0.1 IMD. Buy whole tickets; the first purchase starts a 15-minute round.
Once time is up, finalize to commit a block 3 blocks ahead. After it is mined, finalize ag
Winners claim 40%, 20% and 10% of the pool. With fewer than three tickets, unfilled prizes
Tickets remain in the contract until settlement or an eligible cancellation. The 15% locke
